integrity: Analytic proof with an exact nonnegative stability identity and constructive attainment; finite independent geometric checks supplement but do not prove it.
scientific_limitations: Fixed convex Euclidean polygon, finite boundary-point sets meeting each open side; does not apply to arbitrary interior-point approximants, curved boundaries, or a missing side. Optimal constant is specific to the outer polygon angles.
title: Sharp quadratic area–perimeter deficit inequality for side-spanning inscribed polygons
